auth.createAccountHint: Create an account for your organization. This is not the platform operator.
auth.alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.freeAccountHint: One project, up to two of your machines. You pay for people, not for servers we host.
auth.oauthUnavailable: Google and GitHub are not connected on this hub yet. Use email and password.
auth.panelTagline: Control all your machines from one browser tab.
auth.signInHint: Sign in to reach your fleet.
auth.claimHint: This hub has no owner yet. Claim it to create the admin account.
auth.bootstrapHint: The hub printed this to its log at start, and wrote it to bootstrap-token in its data directory. It proves you are the operator of this hub rather than someone who found the address, and it stops working once the hub is claimed.
auth.forgotHint: Enter the email on the account. If it exists, we will send a reset link.
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset email is on its way. Check spam if it is not in the inbox.
auth.resetHint: Choose a new password for this account. The link works once, for one hour.
auth.invalidReset: This reset link is missing or invalid.
auth.invalidInvite: This invite link is missing or invalid.
auth.inviteHint: Open the invite, set a password, and you are in. The link works once, for seven days.
auth.inviteHintNamed: Join {{org}} as {{role}}. The link works once, for seven days.

errors.planLimit: This plan does not allow that. Open Plans to continue.

validation.email: Please enter a valid email address

admin.title: This hub
admin.subtitle: Everyone who can sign in here, and every organization on this installation.
admin.name: Name
admin.noAccounts: No accounts yet. This hub still runs on the operator password it was set up with.
admin.kpisHint: Counts since we started recording. Activation also uses live projects, workers, and finished tasks.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Pay for people in {{org}}. Machines stay yours — we never host workers.
plans.selfhost: This hub is self-hosted. There is no catalogue wall and no payment against us.
plans.noOrg: Plans belong to an organization. Create one first.
plans.paid: Payment received. You can invite people now.
plans.invoiceHint: Polish companies need a NIP. After payment we issue the VAT invoice in Fakturownia and send it to KSeF.
plans.notWired: Checkout is not configured on this hub yet. Invoice details still save.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: Who belongs to {{org}}, and what they may do. You are its {{role}}.
people.noOrgTitle: You are not in an organization.
people.noOrgHint: This hub signed you in with its operator password, which predates accounts. Organizations belong to accounts.
people.inviteHint: They get a link that works once, for seven days. Copy it here; hosted also sends mail.
people.inviteLinkOnce: Copy this link now — it will not be shown again.

boarding.nameHint: People and projects belong to it. You can rename it later.
boarding.templateHint: Computer program and I'll decide later are ready today. Other kinds will light up when a worker can run them.
boarding.projectHint: A project is a place to run work. You can add a repository and a worker next.
boarding.repoHint: This is a software project, so a clone URL is where review will land. Skip if the worker already has the checkout.
boarding.repoNoGit: No repository yet? Create one on <github>GitHub</github> — free — then paste the clone URL here.
boarding.workerHint: Paste this on the machine that will run the work. It installs the connector and keeps it running.
boarding.enrollWait: Waiting for the machine to join…
boarding.enrollExpire: The link is single-use and expires in 15 minutes.
boarding.noGatewayHint: The enroll command is created on the project gateway. Restart the hub with --gateway-url, or skip and add a worker later.
boarding.taskHint: This proves the worker can take a job from the hub and report back. You can skip and do it from Tasks.
boarding.unnamedHint: This is the generic name. Rename it under People when you are ready.

code.operatorEmptyHint: You operate this hub from Administration. A project belongs to a customer organization, not to the platform operator.
code.deleteHint: This removes the project from the hub. Files on {{machine}} stay. Type the name below exactly — pasting is disabled.
code.missing: This project is not on the hub.

claim.organizationHint: People and projects belong to an organization. Left blank, it is called default; you can rename it later.

tasks.title: Run a command
tasks.subtitle: Submit a task to the project gateway. A worker runs it and reports back — you don't decide when it's done.

launchHint.exec: The worker runs the command and reports when it exits. This is the default.
launchHint.process: The worker starts a child process and waits for that child. Use this on Windows without tmux.
launchHint.send_keys: The worker types into tmux and waits for a marker. The worker must have tmux.

tasks.noOnlineWorkers: No workers are online. Enroll a worker, then submit again.
